pages.title: Tarot for the pattern between you
pages.intro: Draw three cards for your inner truth, the shared pattern, and the care that keeps the connection honest.
pages.questionLabel: What relationship dynamic needs your attention?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Example: What keeps repeating when we try to feel close?
pages.journalPrompt: Name one need you can own and one assumption you can check.
pages.resultCopy: A relationship becomes clearer when insight is paired with consent, listening, and a specific request.
pages.metaDescription: A free love tarot spread for understanding relationship patterns, needs, and respectful communication.

pages.title: Past, present, and next in love
pages.intro: Use three cards to honour what shaped your heart, what is true now, and what kind of care may come next.
pages.questionLabel: What part of your love story are you reflecting on?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Example: What can I learn from the last relationship before I begin again?
pages.journalPrompt: Write one lesson you will carry forward without carrying the old hurt.
pages.resultCopy: The future stays open. Let the cards help you choose a kinder pattern in the present.
pages.metaDescription: Reflect on your love story with a free three-card past, present, and next tarot reading.

pages.title: Should I reach out? A love tarot pause
pages.intro: Draw one card, then check the intention, timing, and safety behind the impulse to contact someone.
pages.questionLabel: What do you hope reaching out will create?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Example: Would a short message support a healthier conversation?
pages.journalPrompt: Before sending anything, write the outcome you can accept even without a reply.
pages.resultCopy: The card offers a pause; respect boundaries, consent, and your own emotional safety before acting.
pages.metaDescription: A free yes-or-no love tarot reflection for deciding whether reaching out supports a healthy conversation.

pages.title: Your daily heart tarot card
pages.intro: Draw one card for the feeling, boundary, or moment of tenderness worth noticing today.
pages.questionLabel: Where could your heart use more care today?
pages.questionPlaceholder: Optional: name a feeling you want to meet gently.
pages.journalPrompt: Choose one small act of care that does not depend on someone else’s response.
pages.resultCopy: Take what feels useful and leave the rest. A daily card is an invitation to presence, not prediction.
pages.metaDescription: Draw a free daily love tarot card for a grounded emotional check-in.
